source: Dataset source: Self-constructed fallback 4-category evaluation set (FakeAVCeleb unanswered, AV-Deepfake1M rejected). Video from FaceForensics++, audio from ASVspoof 2019 LA eval.. Never report this as a FakeAVCeleb result unless the manifest's own source field says so.
method: Grid search over |p_video - p_audio| >= T as the disagreement predictor, F1 against ground truth (RVFA/FVRA = should disagree, RVRA/FVFA = should not).
